title: Main board ANOVA_PRO_MAIN_V2.0 - component side
source: FCC ID 2APBOAN600, internal-photos exhibit 3999178 (2018 sample), page 2, lower photo (779x536)

callouts.label: TI CC3220S Wi-Fi MCU
callouts.part: CC3220SM2ARGK, VQFN-64 9x9 mm, Cortex-M4 + Wi-Fi NWP, no internal flash
callouts.note: Main Wi-Fi SoC. The S (non-F) variant boots its application image from external SPI serial flash into RAM, so firmware lives in the SOIC-8 next to it. Refdes is hidden under the chip label area.

callouts.label: SOIC-8: SPI serial flash for CC3220 (probable)
callouts.note: Only 8-pin package next to the CC3220S, which needs an external SPI flash. Primary recovery target: read with a SOIC clip only when the board is unpowered or with the CC3220 held in reset. Read the marking on the real board.

callouts.label: TI CC2640R2F Bluetooth LE SoC
callouts.part: CC2640R2F, VQFN-48 7x7 mm, Cortex-M3, 128 KB internal flash, ROM serial bootloader
callouts.marking: CC2640 / R2F / TI 813 / P305 G4 (printed upside down in photo)
callouts.note: Second MCU with its own firmware (FCC BLE report: Bluetooth LE 4.2). Debug via cJTAG/JTAG. Which MCU drives display/keys and talks to the power board is still unknown.

callouts.label: 4-position DIP switch (FCC sample only)
callouts.note: Not fitted on raptox's production unit (empty footprint). Hypothesis: CC3220 SOP boot-mode straps. Next to R533/R535/R577.

callouts.label: 3-pin header (FCC sample only) - UART?
callouts.note: Fitted on the FCC sample, empty holes on raptox's unit (pin count confirmed from raptox's photos). Near R573/R579/R580 and TP28/TP29. Candidate CC3220 UART (TX/RX/GND).

callouts.label: Tag-Connect style 6-pad debug footprint
callouts.part: TC2030-style: 2x3 pads + 3 alignment holes; pins 1, 2, 5, 6 marked
callouts.note: Sits back-to-back with J38 on the LED side. Typical TI usage: JTAG/SWD or cJTAG (TMS, TCK, RESET, VDD, GND). Likely one footprint per MCU (CC3220S / CC2640R2F). Verify by continuity.

callouts.label: 30-pin FPC connector to power board
callouts.note: White ribbon to J8 on the power board (see assembly photo). Carries supply rails and control/sense signals; the pinout is TODO.

callouts.label: 2-pin speaker connector
callouts.note: Yellow/black pair into the housing (assembly photo). A community repair report mentions 'speaker wires' on the display board, so this is probably the beeper/speaker.

callouts.label: 2 through-hole pads
callouts.note: Next to C588. Wire solder point or jumper. Function unknown.

callouts.label: QFN IC, unidentified
callouts.marking: '3737' legible, first line unreadable in the FCC photo
callouts.note: Same position and '3737' as U14 on raptox's board, which reads T3018 / 3737: probably the same part. Candidates: LED matrix driver (about 135 discrete LEDs on the other side) or capacitive-touch controller.

callouts.label: small QFN IC, unidentified
callouts.note: Surrounded by TP21-TP26 (good probing points). Near U2 and J9.

callouts.label: small IC, unidentified
callouts.note: Next to R589/R590. Could be an I2C sensor, EEPROM or level shifter.

callouts.label: small SOT-package IC (regulator?)
callouts.part: SOT-23-5 on raptox's board (own close-up); looked like a 3-lead SOT-89/SOT-223 in this low-res photo
callouts.note: Probably a linear regulator generating a logic rail. Measure input/output on the real board.

callouts.label: small 6-lead IC
callouts.note: Next to the FPC connector J8. Possibly ESD protection, a level shifter or a load switch on the power-board interface.

callouts.label: Antenna keep-out zone (BLE side)
callouts.note: Nearest antenna zone to CC2640R2F (U7). FCC reports list PCB antennas: BLE 2.21 dBi, Wi-Fi 2.45 dBi.

callouts.label: Antenna keep-out zone (Wi-Fi side)
callouts.note: Nearest antenna zone to CC3220S.

callouts.label: Metal spring contacts (3x)
callouts.note: Probably ground/shield contacts to the housing or bezel. Possibly antenna-related.

callouts.label: Test points near CC2640R2F
callouts.note: Test-point cluster with traces running toward U7. Candidates: BLE debug or UART. Probe these on the real board.

callouts.label: Test-point cluster
callouts.note: Next to the left spring contact and U17.

callouts.label: Discrete circuit (Q3, C605, R591-R594)
callouts.note: Function unknown. Candidates: buzzer driver, reset/power-good or supervisor.

callouts.label: Handwritten sticker '2.0.2'
callouts.note: Probably the firmware or hardware version of the FCC sample (2018). Also blue pen marks '33/35' nearby.

callouts.label: Production label (Data Matrix) + 260 C / Pb-free marks
callouts.note: PCB serial/lot label. Compare with raptox's unit to detect revision changes.
